# Discussion categories

The board is tuned for a prompt library. Issues carry bugs and site reports;
discussions carry everything that benefits from a conversation.

| Category | Answerable | Use it for |
|---|---|---|
| **Announcements** | no | Releases, notable additions, changes to the frontmatter contract. Maintainer posts. |
| **Q&A** | yes | How to use or adapt an existing prompt. The answer that solves it should be a discussion reply, not a private message. |
| **Prompt Requests** | yes | Propose a prompt that does not exist yet. Scope the idea here before writing a draft. |
| **Ideas** | no | Suggestions about the library itself: new generators, a search feature, an opencode-native packaging format. |
| **Show and tell** | no | What you built with these prompts. Screenshots and architecture notes are welcome. |
| **Adoption Reports** | no | How you wired a prompt into your workflow, and what happened. Useful even when it did not work. |
| **General** | no | Anything that fits nowhere else. |

## Before you post

**Is it a bug in the text?** Use the issue form. A prompt that is factually
wrong or would cause an agent to do something harmful is a bug report, not a
discussion.

**Is it a security issue?** Do not post it. Use private reporting, linked in
[SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

**Is it a finished prompt?** Open a pull request, not a discussion. Use
**Prompt Requests** only to agree on scope first.
